data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is not substantive but technical: Report 1 failed due to LLM API errors (HTTP 400 BadRequestError) during the full file review phase, resulting in an inconclusive verdict. learnings: API failures should be distinguished from substantive inconclusive findings - a model that crashes or times out provides no security signal and should be flagged as a tool error rather than an inconclusive verdict
The audit tool should implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms when API calls fail, to avoid wasting the entire audit due to transient errors
